safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports a tingling sensation around the lips.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies tingling around the lips; generated mentions tingling in throat/chest and no lip swelling but not lip tingling.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting perioral/lip tingling can downplay a key early mucosal symptom of an evolving allergic reaction/anaphylaxis and may reduce urgency in downstream triage or decision-making. In a patient already reporting breathing difficulty after a sting, missing this detail could contribute to delayed recognition/escalation.
